verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents filtering findings by severity or confidence, or failing a CI build only above a severity threshold. The nearby material is adjacent and does not count: reachability flagging, valid-secret prioritization, and AI noise reduction help prioritize findings but are not severity or confidence gating. The axis clearly applies to a SAST tool, so absence of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter and gate on findings by severity or confidence so low-value noise does not block builds
